cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.category_name, ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price::numeric * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount::numeric)), 2) AS net_revenue FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id JOIN order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Beverages' GROUP BY c.category_name

cases.reference_sql: SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS employee_name, ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price::numeric * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount::numeric)), 2) AS net_revenue FROM employees e JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id WHERE e.last_name = 'Peacock' GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name

cases.name: NW144 Annual sales report 1997
cases.prompt: 生成 1997 年销售概览报告，包含订单量、折后净销售额和平均运费，并给出文字结论。用于报告的最终查询只返回 order_year、order_count、两位小数的 net_revenue 和 avg_freight。
cases.reference_sql: WITH order_summary AS ( SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS order_count, ROUND(AVG(freight::numeric), 2) AS avg_freight FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '1998-01-01' ), revenue_summary AS ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price::numeric * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount::numeric)), 2) AS net_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '1998-01-01' ) SELECT 1997::int AS order_year, os.order_count, rs.net_revenue, os.avg_freight FROM order_summary os CROSS JOIN revenue_summary rs

cases.name: NW146 Customer order frequency distribution
cases.prompt: 计算客户订单频次分布：先统计每个客户的订单数，再统计每种订单数对应的客户数量。返回 order_count 和 customer_count，按 order_count 升序。没有订单的客户也要计入 order_count=0。
cases.reference_sql: WITH customer_orders AS ( SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(o.order_id)::int AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ) SELECT order_count, COUNT(*)::int AS customer_count FROM customer_orders GROUP BY order_count ORDER BY order_count

cases.name: NW147 Product reorder risk
cases.prompt: 列出仍在售且现有库存加在途库存不高于补货点的产品。返回 product_name、units_in_stock、units_on_order 和 reorder_level，按 product_name 升序。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT product_name, units_in_stock, units_on_order, reorder_level FROM products WHERE discontinued = 0 AND units_in_stock + units_on_order <= reorder_level ORDER BY product_name

cases.name: NW148 Late shipment rate by country
cases.prompt: 按收货国家计算已发货订单的晚发货比例，晚发货定义为 shipped_date > required_date。返回 ship_country、shipped_orders 和两位小数的 late_pct，按 late_pct 降序、ship_country 升序。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ship_country, COUNT(*)::int AS shipped_orders, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE shipped_date > required_date) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS late_pct FROM orders WHERE shipped_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ship_country ORDER BY late_pct DESC, ship_country ASC

cases.name: NW149 Customer value ranking

cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.company_name, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order_date, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)::int AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price::numeric * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount::numeric)), 2) AS net_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, c.company_name ASC LIMIT 10

cases.reference_sql: SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS manager_name, COUNT(e.employee_id)::int AS direct_reports FROM employees m JOIN employees e ON e.reports_to = m.employee_id GROUP BY m.employee_id, m.first_name, m.last_name ORDER BY direct_reports DESC, manager_name ASC
